title: Domain workflow instance
description: A durable domain workflow instance: the correlation record that ties a target's independent operation executions, human decisions, scheduled intents (timers), retries, and terminal state into one coherent history (EXECUTION-MODES.md D4). It is owned by the backlog/initiative domain storage (it lives beside items/initiatives) and is versioned and idempotent. IMPORTANT: it does NOT replace domain truth — the backlog item / initiative documents remain the source of truth for status, membership, plan_ref, and acceptance criteria. The workflow instance records the coordination layer (which operations ran, in what order, with what outcomes and decisions) and never duplicates or overrides the domain fields. Each operation execution is correlated by an idempotency key so replays are safe.

instance_id.description: Stable durable identity of this workflow instance.

domain.description: The domain entity this workflow coordinates. The entity's own document remains the source of truth; this instance never restates its status/membership/plan_ref.

strategy.description: For an initiative domain, the member-item coordination strategy configuration (member-item-strategy.schema.json) this workflow runs. Absent for a backlog-item domain and for initiatives run through a phase-graph operating mode instead of member-item coordination.

operations.description: Append-only history of operation executions correlated under this workflow, newest last.

decisions.description: Human decisions recorded against the workflow (e.g. review-decide accept/fail, mode switch approval).

timers.description: Scheduled/timed intents the workflow is waiting on (auto-start-after, retry backoff, follow-up scheduling).

legal_actions.description: The domain-action names currently legal from this workflow's state (a snapshot for operators/UI; the transition policy is the SSOT). Every entry must be a registered action name.

idempotency_keys.description: Keys already consumed by correlated operation executions, so a replayed dispatch is a no-op rather than a duplicate.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version; every mutation increments it.

WorkflowState.description: Coordination-layer lifecycle state. Terminal states are closed; the domain entity's own status remains authoritative for its lifecycle.

provenance_digest.description: Digest of the immutable execution-provenance record (execution-provenance.schema.json).

run_id.description: The live agent-run id the operation's round is dispatched under (set on the non-blocking live start), correlating a delivered round back to this operation for CommitResult. Absent on the synchronous simulation path and before a live run association is known.

outcome.description: The operation contract outcome name this execution reported, when terminal.

at_version.description: Workflow version at which the decision was recorded.

intent.description: Why the timer exists (e.g. auto-start-after, retry-backoff).

action.description: The registered domain action to fire when the timer elapses. Mutually exclusive with operation.

operation.description: The operation to Invoke when the timer elapses (e.g. advance to the next workshop round). Mutually exclusive with action.

not_before.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant the intent becomes eligible.
